name: hindi-names-probe-v01
question: Does a drop-in model fix the Devanagari person-name miss recorded in gliner-label-fp-v01..v03?
set: 8 synthetic lines with a person name (7 Hindi, 1 English control), 16 Hindi UI labels without one; scored alone; person-name threshold 0.3; author-written

results.note: finds the bare name 'प्रिया शर्मा' at 0.34 when scored alone, but not inside the serialised DOM line (gliner-label-fp-v03)
two of the four 'hits' are fragments ('शर्मा' alone, 'दव' from 'यादव'); the whole name would still reach the planner
not run: gated repository (403). Accepting its terms needs the account owner (Francis).

decision: No model swap: neither GLiNER checkpoint finds Hindi names reliably. Hindi names stay an open privacy gap (ROAST round 30). Options for Francis: accept IndicNER's terms on the Hub so it can be measured as a Devanagari-only second layer, or treat any Devanagari name-shaped text near a name cue as uncertain.
